samples.question: A ball dropped from the black dot falls straight down, and each time it meets a slanted bar it slides to that bar's lower end and keeps falling from there. Four bars are colored and one bar is red. Drop the ball twice: first on the board exactly as drawn, then on the board with only the red bar re-leaned the opposite way. Exactly one colored bar is met on the second drop but not on the first. Which colored bar is it? Answer blue, green, orange, or purple.
